notes: Model registry for the benchmark. To add a model, add an entry. `adapter` selects how it is invoked. The 'claude-cli' adapter shells out to the local `claude` CLI with --model, matching how Aurora itself calls Claude. Future adapters (openai-api, gemini-api) would call those vendors' APIs directly from the runner WITHOUT making them first-class Aurora providers, so Aurora stays Claude-only by design. An entry with `kind:"mcp"` is a whole-wrapper CONTESTANT reached over MCP (one answer() tool), run hermetically with only its env_allow vars present and an isolated state dir — see docs/design/mcp-contestants.md.
